title: Creamy Mediterranean Fish Stew
description: A rich and flavorful stew made with the freshest fish and Mediterranean herbs, perfect for a cozy evening meal. This hearty stew is sure to become a family favorite.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large, heavy-bottomed pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the cod fillets and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they develop a nice sear.
Add the canned diced tomatoes, feta cheese, chopped parsley, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Stir to combine and bring the stew to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let cook for 10-12 minutes, until the fish is cooked through and the flavors have melded together.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
